whetstone-apply.name: Whetstone: apply
whetstone-apply.description: Fix, reject, defer or escalate each actionable finding and write .review/current/decisions.json
whetstone-apply.author: Kirill Andriychuk

whetstone-review.name: Whetstone: review
whetstone-review.description: Review the branch with pr-review-toolkit and write .review/current/findings.json (cc-review Findings)
whetstone-review.author: Kirill Andriychuk

whetstone-shim-check.name: Whetstone: shim check
whetstone-shim-check.description: Decide the defect class, other occurrences and fix strategy of each actionable finding; write .review/current/shim-check.json
whetstone-shim-check.author: Kirill Andriychuk

whetstone-triage.name: Whetstone: triage
whetstone-triage.description: Decide with the decision step whether each blocking finding is bikeshedding; write .review/current/triage.json
whetstone-triage.author: Kirill Andriychuk

whetstone.name: Whetstone
whetstone.description: Review a branch with pr-review-toolkit, drop bikeshedding, choose patch or class fixes, and fix within the PR until nothing important is left.
whetstone.author: Kirill Andriychuk
